description: Source code implementing cryptographic modes (CFB mode) for BoringSSL/OpenSSL, including encryption and decryption functions, block processing, and internal cryptographic operations.

methods.name: CRYPTO_cfb128_encrypt
methods.description: Performs CFB mode encryption or decryption on input data using AES.

methods.name: CRYPTO_cfb128_1_encrypt
methods.description: Performs bit-level CFB encryption/decryption with 1-bit segments.

methods.name: CRYPTO_cfb128_8_encrypt
methods.description: Performs byte-level CFB encryption/decryption with 8-bit segments.

methods.name: cfbr_encrypt_block
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts a single block of data with variable bit length in CFB mode.
